reasoning.details: Uses a scoped AppProcess layer and runs both positive/negative controls in separate Bun OS processes. Fixture builds a separate env object, never mutates parent process.env, uses explicit cwd and extendEnv:false, awaits AppProcess.run, and removes only its private temporary root after completion. --isolate and the strict/nonce changes belong to the child process.

Constructs test-only nodes and invokes synchronous Host.merge validation. Host.merge returns arrays/merged layer values; it does not build a runtime, apply replacements globally or close AppProcess. No parent environment mutation or process launch in these assertions.

Each mode acquires a private root and awaits AppProcess.run with bounded output before disposing it. Fixture's parent-side build writes only under the private root and installs plugins in Bun.build options, not a global runtime plugin. ATLAS/TMP environment mutations are inside actorSource, executed in another PID, with its own finally cleanup. Parser helper only resolves/reads installed package files. The test asserts a distinct PID, child cleanup and absence of the fixture root.

These predecessor calls share the native Omni subsystem with the later broker, but AppProcess.run scopes child ownership and awaits output/exit. That shared subsystem is a possible investigation boundary, not demonstrated causal evidence. No Env teardown or global service replacement is established by the predecessor paths.
